experiences.name: Maasai Mara Great Migration Safari
experiences.description: Witness the world-famous Great Migration where millions of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles cross the Mara River in one of nature's most spectacular events. Game drives in open 4x4 vehicles offer close encounters with the Big Five including lions, elephants, leopards, buffaloes, and rhinos in their natural habitat.
experiences.location: Maasai Mara National Reserve, Narok County

experiences.name: Amboseli Elephant Watching with Kilimanjaro Backdrop
experiences.description: Observe some of Africa's largest elephant herds roaming freely against the iconic snow-capped backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro. Amboseli is renowned for its large elephant populations and offers exceptional photography opportunities with stunning landscapes, swamps, and diverse birdlife including over 400 species.

experiences.name: Ol Pejeta Conservancy Rhino Tracking
experiences.description: Track endangered black and white rhinos on foot with expert guides at one of Africa's most successful wildlife conservancies. Ol Pejeta is home to the last two northern white rhinos on Earth and offers intimate wildlife encounters including chimpanzee sanctuary visits, night game drives, and conservation education experiences.

experiences.name: Lake Nakuru Flamingo & Big Cat Safari
experiences.description: Explore the alkaline shores of Lake Nakuru, famous for its breathtaking flocks of pink flamingos that paint the lake's edge. The surrounding national park is a sanctuary for both black and white rhinos, Rothschild giraffes, leopards, and lions. The diverse ecosystem offers incredible birdwatching with over 450 recorded species.
experiences.location: Lake Nakuru National Park, Rift Valley

experiences.name: Maasai Cultural Village & Sundowner Experience
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in the rich traditions of the Maasai people with an authentic village visit including traditional dances, warrior jumping ceremonies, and insights into their centuries-old nomadic lifestyle. End the day with a classic African sundowner — sipping drinks on the savannah as the sun sets over the Mara plains surrounded by wildlife.
